name: Forever Hatchers! 🥚
desc:
👋 Welcome to Forever Hatchers!

🥚 Hatch Every Pet! Secret ones hide in certain eggs.. will you hatch them all?
🌏 Unlock 9 unique zones! 
✨ Upgrade your stats around the map!
⭐ Buy items from vending machines to become OP!
💎 Climb the leader boards!
🧪 Enchant your pets! Ability to hatch more eggs!

🎈 Like and favourite the game to support us!

🎁 Made by Noob Slayers! 🎁
